JUDGEMENT IS REACHED BY STIPULATION. DEFENDANT, MAXIMILIAN CRUZ, CAN STAY AT 520 NATOMA, #L, SAN FRANCISCO UNDER THE FOLLOWING CONDITIONS: MAXMILIAN CRUZ SHALL PAY APRIL BACK RENT OF $497.00 BY 6-9-94. BACK RENT FOR MAY OF $497.00 SHALL BE PAID BY 6-15-94 BY MONEY ORDER. JULY RENT SHALL BE PAID IN TWO PARTS, $248 ON 7-5-94 AND $248 ON 7-15-94. AUGUST RENT AND THE RENT FOR EACH SUCCEEDING MONTH WILL BE PAID ON OR ABOUT THE FIFTH OF EACH MONTH. JUNE RENT OF $497 PLUS ATTORNEY FEES OF $882 EQUALING $1379.00 SHALL BE PAID OVER A TEN MONTH PERIOD. PAYMENTS OF $137.90 SHALL BE DUE ON THE EIGHTEENTH OF EACH MONTH STARTING 8-18-94. THIS CASE SHALL BE DISMISSED AND TENANT RESTORED TO REGULAR TENANCY IF HE MAKES ALL PAYMENTS. IF DEFENDANT, MAXIMILIAN CRUZ, MISSES A PAYMENT, HE WILL RECEIVE A TWO DAY NOTICE OF EX PARTE MOTION FOR EVICTION. EACH SIDE SHALL WAIVE ALL CAUSES OF ACTION AGAINST EACH OTHER. PLAINTIFF'S ATTORNEY SHALL PREPARE JUDGEMENT.
STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT, SIGNED BY ALL PARTIES,
